name: Custom Shape Drink Coaster And Tag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

Made from high-quality 5mm acrylic, available in three stunning material options:

- Transprent Acrylic – Sleek and minimal for a modern look.

- Broken Glass Acrylic – Adds a sparkling, textured effect that catches the light beautifully.

- Starburst Acrylic – Features a radiant finish with shimmering lines for a dazzling appearance.

- Each material is durable, lightweight and designed to showcase your custom design vividly.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Drink Coaster Size: 4 x 4 inches ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm

- Drink Tag Size: 2 x 2 inches ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm

- You can choose to purchase the coaster and drink tag separately or as a matching set, depending on your needs.

- The size of custom shape so the product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed with advanced UV printing technology, ensuring crisp, vibrant, and long-lasting images. Your custom text or artwork will look sharp and professional on every surface. Printed on both sides.

 

  • Functionality:

- Drink Coaster: Protects tabletops from heat and moisture, perfect for home, office, or events.

- Drink Tag: Clips onto glass rims, helping guests easily identify their drinks—great for weddings, parties, or gatherings.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A delightful and personalized gift suitable for all ages and occasions—from birthdays and holidays to weddings and corporate giveaways. Customizable with names, quotes, or messages to make it truly memorable.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x  Drink Coaster or 1 x  Drink Tag or  Full set (1x  Drink Coaster and 1 x  Drink Tag)

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
